subject: Post-call recap: PHI boundaries, BAA availability, and deploy options
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Amy Patel <amy.patel@medixhealth.com>, procurement <procurement@medixhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: PHI boundaries, BAA availability, and deploy options

Hi Amy / Medix procurement team,

Thanks again for taking the time on today's discovery call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so everyone has the same context: 

Summary from our call:
- Use case: patient lab-results ingestion + contextual summarization for care teams; includes patient identifiers (MRN, DOB) and structured lab values. No full imaging files in scope for initial pilot.
- Performance needs: sub-1s per token tail latency on short prompts for clinical UI.
- Compliance ask: must understand BAA availability, how PHI can be handled, and which deployment modes are eligible for PHI workloads.

Open items / asks (what we need from you):
1) Confirm whether Medix wants PHI processed in a Private deployment only (VPC or on-prem) or whether Dedicated/Hosted with contractual controls would be acceptable.
2) Please share your vendor security questionnaire (attached is our SOC 2 summary; we can provide full report under NDA).
3) Any specific PHI categories you consider out-of-scope (e.g., free-text clinical notes vs. structured identifiers).

What we can provide next (our commitments):
- Redwood can execute a standard BAA for customers processing PHI. We have both VPC-private and on-premise deployment paths for PHI; Hosted API is generally reserved for non-PHI unless an enterprise Private arrangement is put in place.
- High-level SOC 2 Type II summary attached. Full SOC 2 report available under NDA; we can route via legal.
- If Private deployment is preferred, we will coordinate with our Private team to scope networking and key management (KMS/HSM) needs.

Proposed next steps:
- Medix confirms deployment preference + returns completed Vendor Security Questionnaire (VSQ) by EOD Wed 2/17 if possible.
- Redwood legal prepares BAA draft once VSQ is received (can be reviewed in parallel).
- Tentative follow-up call: Thu 2/18 10:00 AM PT to review answers and align on timeline.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (high-level)

Thanks — happy to adjust timing.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | (650) 555-0182

--
Redwood Inference — Production-ready LLM inference (Hosted, Dedicated, Private)

From: Dr. Amy Patel <amy.patel@medixhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@medixhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: PHI boundaries, BAA availability, and deploy options

Vanessa — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Scope of PHI: initial pilot will include patient identifiers (MRN, name, DOB), limited clinical notes (short visit summaries), and discrete lab values. We are not sending imaging files or long free-text histories in the pilot.
- Deployment preference: Medix strongly prefers PHI to be processed within a Private (VPC) or on-prem deployment. We will consider Dedicated with strict VPC isolation if a contractual BAA & network controls are in place, but we cannot use your public Hosted API for PHI.
- SOC 2 / Compliance: please send your SOC 2 Type II report (or a redacted copy) and the SOC 2 controls matrix; procurement will review for our GRC team.

Attached is our vendor questionnaire (fillable). Also, procurement would like a draft BAA to review — do you have a standard template you send to customers?

Happy to confirm the follow-up call once we have the VSQ back to you.

Thanks,
Amy
Chief Product Officer, MedixHealth
amy.patel@medixhealth.com

Attachment: Medix_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Fillable.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Medix PHI handling notes / legal follow-up

Looping in a quick internal note after Vanessa's thread with Medix: 

- Legal/Compliance: please prep our standard BAA and note any carve-outs for telemetry/aggregated metrics. We should be ready to provide the full SOC 2 report under NDA; SOC 2 Type II covers our infra and change controls since 2025.
- Engineering: if Medix requires VPC-private deployment, we will need to scope network egress rules, customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) and whether on-prem is necessary for their pilot.
- Commercial: deal_id RWF-2027-MDX-01; consider Dedicated reserved capacity if they want predictable throughput and lower latency at scale.

Vanessa — I recommend sending the BAA DocuSign link once procurement returns the completed VSQ. Stephanie, can you loop in Legal (CC: legal@redwoodinference.com) to expedite the BAA template?

Thanks,
Marcus
Head of Sales Engineering
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

2) BAA: our legal team has a standard BAA template; I have initiated DocuSign and will send the link once Legal confirms the draft. For transparency, we are comfortable with Private (VPC) or Dedicated with strict network isolation for PHI. Hosted public API is not appropriate for PHI without an explicit Private arrangement.
3) SOC 2: attached is the high-level SOC 2 summary; full report available under NDA.

Proposed meeting: Thu 2/18 10:00 AM PT to review VSQ answers + draft BAA. If that still works for you, I'll calendar-invite and include Marcus + Stephanie.
